title: Sleep Out For The Homeless
description: Sleep Out for the Homeless The Eta Chapter of Phi Beta Sigma Fraternity, Inc. is proud to present “Sleep Out for the Homeless,” a community service and awareness event focused on supporting individuals experiencing homelessness in our community. Throughout the event, members and participants will collect non-perishable food items, clothing, hygiene products, blankets, and other essential supplies that can be donated to individuals and organizations serving those in need. The goal is not only to collect donations, but also to bring awareness to the realities and challenges that people experiencing homelessness face every day. As part of the experience, participants will spend the night outdoors with limited comforts to gain a greater understanding of what it can feel like to lack access to a safe, comfortable place to sleep. While we recognize that one night cannot fully recreate the experience of homelessness, the event is designed to encourage empathy, awareness, compassion, and action. “Sleep Out for the Homeless” is an opportunity for the Eta Chapter, campus organizations, and community members to come together and make a meaningful difference. Through service, education, and giving, we hope to remind our community that everyone deserves dignity, safety, basic necessities, and a place to call home. Event Goals: Collect non-perishable food and essential supplies Collect new and gently used clothing Collect blankets and other basic necessities Raise awareness about homelessness in our community Encourage empathy and community involvement Connect donations with local organizations and individuals who need them Promote the values of service, brotherhood, and community uplift

title: Full Body Meeting
description: Recurring club-wide meetings built around practice, feedback, and growth in a supportive, family-like environment. Members will participate in Table Topics, prepared speeches, and structured speaking exercises while receiving constructive feedback from fellow members. Through consistent repetition and the Aggie Toastmasters framework, our goal is to make effective public speaking feel natural and second nature.

title: Pride vs. Props: What They Don’t Tell You About Greek Life
description: Meet The Iotas. The Zeta Chapter of Iota Phi Theta Fraternity, Inc. is planning "Pride vs. Props: What They Don’t Tell You About Greek Life", an interactive web seminar and candid conversation designed for male students looking to build a lasting legacy on campus and beyond. Get to know the brothers of the Zeta Chapter and engage in a real talk on Greek life, the history and founding principles of Iota Phi Theta (Scholarship, Leadership, Citizenship, Fidelity, and Brotherhood), and what it truly means to find your own lane rather than following the crowd.

title: Santa's Sleigh Sweepers
description: Join us for a festive fusion of creativity, engineering, and holiday cheer at Santa’s Sleigh Sweepers! This hands-on STEAM adventure invites young learners to step into Santa’s workshop and help design, build, and test robotic solutions that keep the sleigh running smoothly for its big night. Participants will rotate through imaginative exploration stations where they will: Build and code holiday‑themed robots to complete merry missions. Navigate snowy obstacle courses that challenge precision, logic, and teamwork. Tackle engineering design tasks inspired by Santa’s seasonal challenges. Explore real-world STEAM concepts through playful, winter‑wonderland activities Throughout the event, learners will engage in authentic STEAM practices including computational thinking, creative problem‑solving, engineering design, and data exploration. Whether they’re programming a robot to deliver presents, designing a sleigh‑repair solution, or discovering how sensors help robots “see” in a snowy environment, participants will experience the joy of innovation wrapped in holiday magic. Perfect for learners ages 3–12, Santa’s Sleigh Sweepers blends imagination with engineering to spark curiosity, confidence, and festive fun.
